verse.verse_1: By the fig and the olive;
verse.verse_3: and by this city (of Makkah), a haven of peace:
verse.verse_4: surely We created man in the best mould;
verse.verse_5: then We reverted him to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. Theirs is a never ending reward.
verse.verse_7: Who, then, can give the lie to you, (O Prophet), about the Reward and the Punishment?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the Greatest of all sovereigns?
